titulo: You built a basement. It flooded. 🌊 #engineering #shorts
descripcion:
From a hole under the house to a basement that stays dry, one problem at a time.

What should we build next?

#engineering #howitworks #basement #sumppump #shorts

lineas.texto: You want more space, so you dig under your house and build a basement. Problem solved!
But the ground around it is full of water, and it pushes right through the walls.
So you coat the outside of the walls with waterproofing. Dry walls!
But after a big storm, the water rises under the floor and pushes up through the cracks.
So you bury a pipe full of holes in gravel, all around the bottom. A French drain.
It catches the water before it can push, and sends it to a pit in the corner.
When the pit fills, a float lifts and switches on a pump, and it throws the water outside.
And a check valve stops that water from falling back down the pipe.
Congratulations! You just built a dry basement. What should we build next?
